name: Time Series Explorer
description: Browser and desktop application to explore time series locally: MATLAB .mat (including OpenModelica and Dymola results), CSV, Excel, Parquet, netCDF, pandas pickle, Micro-Cap and audio files, with time, frequency, distribution, correlation and phase-space views. Files are processed on the user's computer and never uploaded.
